summary: Resolve exact later and custom-event source chains; preserve uncertain classic behavior, all NPC rows and disabled historical callbacks. Guard only later Aid Garuuk branch in mixed Grobb Bregna.

evidence.note: Official December 18 2011 P99 patch explicitly sets Palious Jarten Cure Disease service at ten gold; search index read, direct page cache miss. Exact price and spell purpose match, not a full live settlement certification.

May-July 2003 firsthand observations describe newly appearing city vermin, Cabilis scales, Oggok armadillos and four-item exterminator exchange. Family-era lead, not exact proof for every actor; preserve uncertain sources.
2022 P99 report says Sahizz absent; response infers out-of-era from database entry date. Neither a developer ruling nor exact introduction proof.

Full P99 thread positively connects Harnoff and Yakem restockable HQ ore vendors to February2002 additions. Nilbog, Project Manager, replies November5 2023: Fixed, pending update. Direct page read. This is staff acceptance of the era report, not first attestation. No NPC rows changed.
Archived February 13 2002 patch text adds limited HQ ore vendors to Bazaar, Kaladim and Qeynos. Used with named restockable vendors, not other ore quests.

Exact Tarnic medicine bag to Antidote of the Wind substep links Gandak in Torgiran and required Dulak insignias, positively later Ykesha locations. Guide marks its overall quest unverified; era is also supported by named zone dependency.
Exact Ajrah Leaf to Erudehide Tunic chain, with East Karana treant, documented on another emulator. Supports identity, not P99 values or admission.
Official expansion retrospective identifies mounts and Beastlord as additions introduced by Shadows of Luclin. Used only for era, not gameplay values.

June 13, 2003 contemporary discussion quotes EQLive describing changes made to Befallen with the tabletop module and explicitly directs players to Sir Ariam for a horse. Respondents identify the one-charge bridle and no-rent intermediate.

First-person walkthrough gives skeleton kills, Skeletal Foreman death, Sir Ariam appearance, Ghostly Bridle and Scroll of the Burning Dead, then Sir Artanis turn-in. This matches the exact local chain, not the older Opal/Marnek mystery.
Official March 9, 2016 test patch reports a historical review and changes the Temple-to-Accursed Temple transition from Velious to Luclin.
Exact Gimlik Cogboggle placement at y254,x-468,z18.6 is marked Luclin. Revamped ooze populations are also Luclin. Used with official historical-review era statement and exact local escort source.

EQTraders explicitly identifies Crown of Deceit as requiring Planes of Power; describes Sage Ballic in Plane of Knowledge, old-froglok book exchange, and crown + cloak + purified mana + elf essence reward exchange.

Omens of War Magician Epic 1.5/2.0 guide identifies Ravaging Tsunami Elemental as water elemental prequest target and Vial of Elemental Binding as trigger that makes elementals attack; returns captured elementals to Bantil in Plane of Knowledge.

Aid Garuuk guide documents four PoP drops: Arachnae Fangs, Blood Raven Tailfeather, Swirling Banshee Essence, Wrulon Claw handed to Bregna in Grobb to obtain Troll Receipt for Aid Garuuk in Plane of Knowledge.
April 8 2003 patch notes state Aid Garuuk now knows Bregna moved out of Grobb.

P99 thread quotes 2002 reports describing new Dapper and exact gem + ore + 500pp exchange, started by Allaria. Nilbog states in 2011 that it would be added if classic evidence were found. Thread ends with explicit does-not-exist wiki tag in 2012.
Search-indexed current P99 Non-P99 Content category lists Dapper Blackhammer.

P99 Missing Quest - Al'Kabor's Research (Nov2001) report quotes Dec 4 2001 completed ring discussion, reports Realla not spawning, Noilgin and Lanivon spawning, research notes not dropping on Green; references earlier notes removal discussions.
PQDI identifies Aqaar as Luclin 3.0-99.0 and provides exact script 8720 Phobonomicon to 8732 Medallion of Arcane Scientists, 100000 XP.
P99 Non-P99 Content category positively lists Medallion of the Arcane Scientists, the exact Aqaar reward.
January 2009 discussion explicitly links Lobal Dip Resist Sketch to rogue Master Sketch chain and calls the sketches part of poisons introduced with Omens of War.
Master Sketch page labels Gates of Discord and explicitly lists Bundle of Poisons given to Lobal Postugger for Dip Resist Sketch.
P99 2010 discussion directly disputes whether Firebrand weapons were classic. One commenter says classic; another reports no archived recipe evidence before 2002.
May 28 2015 patch notes explicitly gate Forged Firebrand weapon creation until Brunnel appears to teach recipes.

All four original public ProjectEQ scripts label custom GM event by Shadowblade; full linked chain includes Tan Rope Bridle21800 with mount click2919. Official Luclin mounts introduction independently excludes this exact horse-based race, not all GM events.

after.name: Dapper_Blackhammer
after.lua_content:
-- enabled: false
-- P99 excludes this exact later or custom-event quest chain; full callbacks retained.
-- Evidence: changes/p99-final-uncertainty/review.json
function event_say(e)
	if e.message:findi("hail") then
		e.self:Say("Hello, " .. e.other:GetName() .. ". What brings you to this neck of the mountains? Do you have any work for me?");
	elseif e.message:findi("i have work for you") then
		e.self:Say("Very good. Very good. What I require, if it is the whistler ya seek, is 500 platinum and the two components necessary. Once I have all three, I will then commence ta doin that right away fer ya.");
	end
end

function event_trade(e)
	local item_lib = require("items");
	local level = e.other:GetLevel();

	if level >= 40 then
		if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 12880, item2 = 6552, platinum = 500}) then -- Items: Frontier Ore, Gem of Nimbleness and 500 Platinum
			e.self:Say("I thank ya for ya patronage. Here is what ya came here for. Now be careful who ya point this at. 'Tis quite sharp, " .. e.other:Race() .. ". Be off with ya now as I must get back ta workin here. Good day!");
			e.other:QuestReward(e.self,0,0,0,0,6551,25000); -- Rozzuts Whistler
		end
	else
		if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 12880, item2 = 6552, platinum = 500}) then -- Items: Frontier Ore, Gem of Nimbleness and 500 Platinum
			e.self:Say("How has one as inexperienced as you come across such things?");
			e.other:QuestReward(e.self,0,0,0,500,6551,25000); -- Rozzuts Whistler
			e.other:SummonItem(6552);  -- Gem of Nimbleness
		end
	end
	item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end

-- Converted from ProjectEQ Perl quest script.
-- Source: firiona/Allaria_Sneakyfeet.pl
-- items: 18347

function event_say(e)
	if e.message:findi("hail") then
		e.self:Say("Well hello, " .. e.other:GetName() .. ". What brings you to me? Are you one of the sneaky folk in search of the plans for the Whistler?")
	elseif e.message:findi("plans for the whistler") then
		e.self:Say("I must tell you first off, there was much bloodshed in getting these plans. Three of Rivervale's bravest warrior were killed by Rozzut's brother, Neezee in order to keep the plans out of the hands of the Goblins. Allaria sighs deeply. There was much sorrow over this. The only positive that seemed to come out of the whole ordeal, was the finding of the plans to make the weapon that Rozzut, Chief Zambooz's main assassin uses so effectively. I have now made it my calling to give a copy of these plans to those that are worthy of such knowledge. Do you believe yourself to be worthy of such an honor?")
	elseif e.message:findi("i am worthy") then
		e.self:Say("'Very well then. Here are the plans for the weapon that is said to cut holes into the enemy without much effort. Legend has it that if the wind is blowing, your enemy will be whistling after the fight. But they won't be whistling voluntarily.' Allaria smiles. 'Good luck to you friend.'")
		e.other:SummonItem(18347)
	end
end

before.name: Harnoff_Splitrock
before.lua_content:
-- Converted from ProjectEQ Perl quest script.
-- Source: kaladimb/Harnoff_Splitrock.pl
-- items: 17814, 10952, 10953

function event_say(e)
	if e.message:findi("hail") then
		e.self:Say("Greetins to ya friend Dwarf! I've got some of the finest quality steel ores in all the lands! It's a bit troublesome ta keep a large enough supply of it though, it bein sought after by every smith ya know. If you're needin some cash or ore how bout you [run an errand] fer me?")
	elseif e.message:findi("run an errand") then
		e.self:Say("I was hopin you'd be up fer the job! Take this here crate and fill it with either Small Bricks of Unrefined Ore or Large Bricks of Unrefined Ore and I'll pay ya when ye return.")
		e.other:SummonItem(17814)
	end
end

local function ore_reward(e, exp, platinum)
	e.other:AddEXP(exp)
	e.other:GiveCash(0, 0, 0, platinum)
	e.other:Faction(274, 5, 0)
	e.other:Faction(290, 5, 0)
	e.other:Faction(322, -5, 0)
	e.other:Faction(293, 5, 0)
	e.other:Faction(312, 5, 0)
end

function event_trade(e)
	local item_lib = require("items")
	if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 10952}) then
		ore_reward(e, 2000, 8)
	elseif item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 10953}) then
		ore_reward(e, 3500, 14)
	end
	item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
